title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 370 (Continuation of pending legal proceedings)

content.overview: All suits and other legal proceedings taken by or against the company, or any public officer or member thereof, which are pending at the time of the registration of a company in pursuance of this Part, may be continued in the same manner as if the registration had not taken place.
content.glance: Pending suits and proceedings continue as if registration under this Part had not taken place.
